description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Timestream InfluxDB service in AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, and listing database instances and parameters, including their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: TimestreamInfluxDBClient
classes.description: Client class for Timestream InfluxDB service, extending the generic AWS client.

methods.name: createDbInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new database instance.

methods.name: createDbParameterGroup
methods.description: Creates a new database parameter group.

methods.name: createDbParameterGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new database parameter group.

methods.name: getDbInstance
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific database instance.

methods.name: getDbInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a database instance.

methods.name: getDbParameterGroup
methods.description: Retrieves information about a database parameter group.

methods.name: getDbParameterGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a database parameter group.

methods.name: listDbParameterGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all database parameter groups.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
